ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the medial and proximal surfaces, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal lobe tips, forming an approximate 85:15 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and proximal lobe bases consist of a contiguous low-intensity dark mass. High-contrast white mottling and punctate clusters are concentrated at the distal 10-15% of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression; geometric angle is approximately 140 degrees with a vertical pixel-depth significantly less than 10% of the horizontal fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays irregular, low-amplitude serrations; higher frequency of micro-notching is visible on the distal half of the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge geometry follows a distinct concave curve originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular spots, consistent with previous barnacle attachments, are visible primarily near the outer margins and trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant series of unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are clustered on the ventral surface of the right lobe; several thinner linear marks are visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive intersecting linear rake marks on the right lobe; minor irregular tissue loss/erosion at the terminal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, high-intensity orange/brown focal cluster on the distal edge of the right lobe.
